verses.en: And he heard the words of Laban's sons, saying, Jacob hath taken away all that was our father's; and of that which was our father's hath he gotten all this glory.
verses.sm: Kanana Ua faalogo foi o ia i upu a atalii o Lapana, ua faapea ane, Ua aveesea e Iakopo o mea uma na i lo tatou tama; o mea foi sa i lo tatou tama ua maua ai e ia lena tamaoaiga uma.

verses.en: And Jacob beheld the countenance of Laban, and, behold, it was not toward him as before.
verses.sm: Ua iloa atu foi e Iakopo mata o Lapana, faauta foi, ua le fiafia mai ia te ia pei o anamua.

verses.en: And the LORD said unto Jacob, Return unto the land of thy fathers, and to thy kindred; and I will be with thee.
verses.sm: Ua fetalai mai foi le ALII ia Iakopo, Ina toe foi atu ia i le nuu o ou tama, ma lou aiga, ou te i ai foi ia te ce.

verses.en: And Jacob sent and called Rachel and Leah to the field unto his flock,
verses.sm: Ua aami foi e Iakopo Rasela ma Lea, la te o mai ia te ia i le vao i lana lafu.

verses.en: And said unto them, I see your father's countenance, that it is not toward me as before; but the God of my father hath been with me.
verses.sm: Ua faapea atu foi o ia ia te i laua, Ua ou iloa nei o mata o lo oulua tama, ua le fiafia mai ia te au pei o anamua; a ole Atua o loʻu tama ua ia te au ia.

verses.en: And ye know that with all my power I have served your father.
verses.sm: Ua oulua iloa foi ua ou auauna i lo oulua tamā i loʻu malosi uma lava.

verses.en: And your father hath deceived me, and changed my wages ten times; but God suffered him not to hurt me.
verses.sm: Ua faaʻoleʻole mai foi lo oulua tamā ia te au, ua faasefulu ona feliuai e ia o loʻu totogi; a ua le tuuina atu e le Atua ia leaga ai aʻu ia te ia.

verses.en: If he said thus, The speckled shall be thy wages; then all the cattle bare speckled: and if he said thus, The ringstraked shall be thy hire; then bare all the cattle ringstraked.
verses.sm: A faapea mai o ja, O manu ilaila solo o lou totogi lea, ona fananau mai lea o manu uma i e ilaila solo; a faapea mai o ia, O e tusitusi o lou totogi lea, ona fananau mai lea o manu uma i e tusitusi.

verses.en: Thus God hath taken away the cattle of your father, and given them to me.
verses.sm: O lea ua aveeseina aj e le Atua o manu a lo oulua tama, ma ua foaiina mai ia te au.

verses.en: And it came to pass at the time that the cattle conceived, that I lifted up mine eyes, and saw in a dream, and, behold, the rams which leaped upon the cattle were ringstraked, speckled, and grisled.
verses.sm: Na oo foii ona po e ofi ai tanu, na Ou vaai atu i laʻu miti, faauta foi, o manu poa e na feosofi i luga o manu, ua tusitusi, ma ilaila solo, ma pulepule i latou.

verses.en: And the angel of God spake unto me in a dream, saying, Jacob: And I said, Here am I.
verses.sm: Ua faapea mai foi le agelu a le Atua ia te au i laʻu miti, Iakopo e; ona ou tali atu lea, O a‘u lenei.

verses.en: And he said, Lift up now thine eyes, and see, all the rams which leap upon the cattle are ringstraked, speckled, and grisled: for I have seen all that Laban doeth unto thee.
verses.sm: Ona faapea mai lea o ia, Ina vaai atu ia, ma e iloa atu, o manu poa uma e feosofi i luga o manu e tusitusi, ma ilaila solo, ma pulepule i latou; auà ua ou vaai i mea uma lava ua faia e Lapana ia te oe.

verses.en: I am the God of Beth-el, where thou anointedst the pillar, and where thou vowedst a vow unto me: now arise, get thee out from this land, and return unto the land of thy kindred.
verses.sm: O au o le Atua o Peteli, o le mea na e uuina ai le maa e fai ma faailoga, o le mea na e tauto ai le tautoga ia te au; o lenei, ina tulai ia, ina e tuua ia o lenei nuu, a e foi atu i le nuu o lou aiga.

verses.en: And Rachel and Leah answered and said unto him, Is there yet any portion or inheritance for us in our father's house?
verses.sm: Ona tali mai lea o Rasela ma Lea, ua faapea mai ia te ia, E ai ea se toe vaegáoloa po o se tofi mo i maua ile aiga o lo maua nei tama?

verses.en: Are we not counted of him strangers? for he hath sold us, and hath quite devoured also our money.
verses.sm: E le ua avea ea i maua ma tagata ese la te 1a? aua ua faatauina i maua e ia, ua matuá faaumatia foi e ia a maua ario.

verses.en: For all the riches which God hath taken from our father, that is our's, and our children's: now then, whatsoever God hath said unto thee, do.
verses.sm: O le oloa uma foi ua aveeseina e le Atua na i lo maua tama, o a maua ia, ma a maua fanau; o lenei, o mea uma ua fetalaia mai e le Atua ia te oe, ina faia ia o lea.

verses.en: Then Jacob rose up, and set his sons and his wives upon camels;
verses.sm: Ona tulai lea o lakopo, ua ia faatietie foi ona atalii ma ana ava i luga o kamela;

verses.en: And he carried away all his cattle, and all his goods which he had gotten, the cattle of his getting, which he had gotten in Padan-aram, for to go to Isaac his father in the land of Canaan.
verses.sm: ua ia aveesea foi ana manu uma, ma ana oloa uma ua na maua, o manu na maua e ia, na na maua Patanarama, O le a alu i lona tamá o Isaako i le nuu o Kanana.

verses.en: And Laban went to shear his sheep: and Rachel had stolen the images that were her father's.
verses.sm: Ua alu foi Lapana e sele fulufulu o ana mamce; ua gaoi foi e Rasela o tupua a lona tamá.

verses.en: And Jacob stole away unawares to Laban the Syrian, in that he told him not that he fled.
verses.sm: Ua sola faagaoi Iakopo ia Lapana le Suria, aua na ia le taʻu atu ja te ia o le a sola ia.

verses.en: So he fled with all that he had; and he rose up, and passed over the river, and set his face toward the mount Gilead.
verses.sm: Ua sola lava ia, ma ana mea uma; ua ja tulai, ma laasia i le vaitafe, ma agaʻi atu i le mauga o Kiliata.

verses.en: And it was told Laban on the third day that Jacob was fled.
verses.sm: Ua oo i le aso tolu ona taʻu atu ai lea ia Lapana, ua sola Iakopo.

verses.en: And he took his brethren with him, and pursued after him seven days' journey; and they overtook him in the mount Gilead.
verses.sm: Ona latou o lea ma ona uso, ua tuliloa ia te ia i aso e fitu; ona maua atu lea ia te ia i Je mauga o Kiliata.

verses.en: And God came to Laban the Syrian in a dream by night, and said unto him, Take heed that thou speak not to Jacob either good or bad.
verses.sm: Na afio ane foi le Atua ia Lapana le Suria i le miti i le po, ua faapea mai ai ia te ia, la oe, ne“ e tautala ia lakopo i se lelei po o se leaga.

verses.en: Then Laban overtook Jacob. Now Jacob had pitched his tent in the mount: and Laban with his brethren pitched in the mount of Gilead.
verses.sm: Ua maua atu foi e Lapana o lakopo. Sa faatuina foi e lakopo lona fale ie i le mauga; ua faatuina foi e Lapana ma ona uso o latou fale i le mauga o Kiliata.

verses.en: And Laban said to Jacob, What hast thou done, that thou hast stolen away unawares to me, and carried away my daughters, as captives taken with the sword?
verses.sm: Ua fai atu Lapana ia Iakopo, Se a lena mea ua e faia, ina ua e sola faagaoi ia te au, ma ua e au mai oʻu afafine faatagataotaua?

verses.en: Wherefore didst thou flee away secretly, and steal away from me; and didst not tell me, that I might have sent thee away with mirth, and with songs, with tabret, and with harp?
verses.sm: Se a le mea na e sola faalilolilo ai, ma e alu faagaoi ai ia te au; ma e le taʻu mai ia te au, ia ou tuuina atu foi oe ma le olioli, ma pese, ma le topa, ma le kitara;

verses.en: And hast not suffered me to kiss my sons and my daughters? thou hast now done foolishly in so doing.
verses.sm: ma e le tuu mai ia te au seʻi matou taufeasogi ma oʻu atalii ma oʻu afafine? O lenei, ua e faavalea ina ua e faia lenei mea.

verses.en: It is in the power of my hand to do you hurt: but the God of your father spake unto me yesternight, saying, Take thou heed that thou speak not to Jacob either good or bad.
verses.sm: E mafai ia te au ona faaoo 1a te outou se leaga; a ua fetalai mai le Atua o lo outou tama ia te au i le po anapo, ua faapea mai, Ia oe, neʻi e tautala ia Iakopo i se lelei po o se leaga.

verses.en: And now, though thou wouldest needs be gone, because thou sore longedst after thy father's house, yet wherefore hast thou stolen my gods?
verses.sm: O lenei foi, ua e fia alu lava, aua ua e matuā manao i le aiga o lou tamá; a o le a le mea ua e gaoi ai i oʻu atua?

verses.en: And Jacob answered and said to Laban, Because I was afraid: for I said, Peradventure thou wouldest take by force thy daughters from me.
verses.sm: Ona tali mai lea o Iakopo ia Lapana, ua faapea mai, Na ou sola ina ua ou fefe; auā na ou faapea, ina neʻi e fao ou afafine ia te au.

verses.en: With whomsoever thou findest thy gods, let him not live: before our brethren discern thou what is thine with me, and take it to thee. For Jacob knew not that Rachel had stolen them.
verses.sm: O le e te maua ua i ai ou atua, aua le ola ia; ia e silasila i luma o tatou uso nei i āu mea ua ja te au, ma e ave e oe. Aua ua le iloa e Iakopo ua gaoia e Rasela.

verses.en: And Laban went into Jacob's tent, and into Leah's tent, and into the two maidservants' tents; but he found them not. Then went he out of Leah's tent, and entered into Rachel's tent.
verses.sm: Ona ulufale atu lea o Lapana i le fale ie o Iakopo, ma le fale foi o Lea, atoa ma fale o auauna fafine e toalua, a ua le maua e ia. Ona sau lea o ia nai le fale o Lea, ma ulufale atu i le fale o Rasela.

verses.en: Now Rachel had taken the images, and put them in the camel's furniture, and sat upon them. And Laban searched all the tent, but found them not.
verses.sm: Na ave foi e Rasela tupua, ma tuu ai i le nofoa o le kamela, ua ia nofo' ai foi i o latou luga. Ua suesue foi e Lapana i le fale uma, a ua le maua.

verses.en: And she said to her father, Let it not displease my lord that I cannot rise up before thee; for the custom of women is upon me. And he searched, but found not the images.
verses.sm: Ua fai mai foi oja i lona tamā, Aua neʻi toatamai loʻu alii ina ua le mafai ona ou tulai i ou luma; auā o loo ia te au le uiga o fafine. Ua ia sailiili lava, a ua le maua tupua.

verses.en: And Jacob was wroth, and chode with Laban: and Jacob answered and said to Laban, What is my trespass? what is my sin, that thou hast so hotly pursued after me?
verses.sm: Ona ita lea o Iakopo, ua ia finau atu ja Lapana; ua fai atu Iakopo ia Lapana, ua faapea atu, Se a loʻu leaga? Se a laʻu agasala ina ua e matuā tulituliloa mai ai ja te au?

verses.en: Whereas thou hast searched all my stuff, what hast thou found of all thy household stuff? set it here before my brethren and thy brethren, that they may judge betwixt us both.
verses.sm: O lenei, ua uma ona e suesue i aʻu mea uma, o ifea se mea o mea uma a lou aiga ua e maua? Tuu mai ia iinei i luma o oʻu uso ma ou uso, ina ja latou faamasino mai ia te i taua.

verses.en: This twenty years have I been with thee; thy ewes and thy she goats have not cast their young, and the rams of thy flock have I not eaten.
verses.sm: E luafulu tausaga na ou i ai ja te oE; ua le papā au mamoe fafine ma aų “on fafine, ua ou le ‘ai foi i mamoe poa o lou lafu.

verses.en: That which was torn of beasts I brought not unto thee; I bare the loss of it; of my hand didst thou require it, whether stolen by day, or stolen by night.
verses.sm: O le na saesa ou te lei avatua ia te oe; na ou tauia lava; o le na gaoia i le ao po ua gaoia ile po na e sue mai ia te au.

verses.en: Thus I was; in the day the drought consumed me, and the frost by night; and my sleep departed from mine eyes.
verses.sm: Na faapea ai aʻu; na puapuagatia aʻu i le vevela i le ao, ma le maalili i le po; na le iloa foi sina moe e oʻu mata.

verses.en: Thus have I been twenty years in thy house; I served thee fourteen years for thy two daughters, and six years for thy cattle: and thou hast changed my wages ten times.
verses.sm: Ua faapea ona i ai aʻu i lou aiga i ona tausaga e luafulu; na ou auauna ia te oe i tausaga e sefulu ma le fa mo ou afafine e toalua, a e ono foi tausaga mo au manu ia; ua faasefulu foi ona e feliuai lo'u totogi.

verses.en: Except the God of my father, the God of Abraham, and the fear of Isaac, had been with me, surely thou hadst sent me away now empty. God hath seen mine affliction and the labour of my hands, and rebuked thee yesternight.
verses.sm: Ana le ia te au le Atua o lo'u tama, o le Atua o Aperaamo, ma lē ua mataʻu i ai Isaako, po ua e aufuaina mai lava a'u. Ua silafia e le Atua loʻu puapuaga ma le galuega a oʻu lima, i le ua ia aoai atu ia te oe i le po anapo.

verses.en: And Laban answered and said unto Jacob, These daughters are my daughters, and these children are my children, and these cattle are my cattle, and all that thou seest is mine: and what can I do this day unto these my daughters, or unto their children which they have born?
verses.sm: Ona tali mai lea o Lapana ia lakopo, ua faapea mai, O fafine nei o Ou afafine ia, O tama nei foi o oʻu atalii ia, o manu nei foi o atu manu ia, o mea uma foi ua e iloa atu nei o aʻu lava ia mea; o oʻu afafine nei foi, se a se mea ou te faja ia te i laua i le aso nei, po o a la fanau ua fananau ai i laua?

verses.en: Now therefore come thou, let us make a covenant, I and thou; and let it be for a witness between me and thee.
verses.sm: O lenei, sau ia, ina fai ia sa ta mavaega; ia fai foi lea ma molimau ia te i taua.

verses.en: And Jacob took a stone, and set it up for a pillar.
verses.sm: Ona tago lea o Iakopo i le maa, ma faatu ai e fai ma faailoga.

verses.en: And Jacob said unto his brethren, Gather stones; and they took stones, and made an heap: and they did eat there upon the heap.
verses.sm: Ua fai atu foi Iakopo i ona uso, Ina faapotopoto mai ia o maa; ona au mai lea e i latou o maa, ma fai ai le faupuega; ona latou aai ai lea i luga o le faupuega.

verses.en: And Laban called it Jegarsahadutha: but Jacob called it Galeed.
verses.sm: Ua faaigoa ai e Lapana o !Ikasetuta; a ua faaigoa ai e Iakopo o 2Kaleta.

verses.en: And Laban said, This heap is a witness between me and thee this day. Therefore was the name of it called Galeed;
verses.sm: Ua fai atu foi e Lapana, E fai lenei faupuega ma molimau ia te i taua i le aso nei; o le mea lea na faaigoa ai lona igoa o Kaleta;

verses.en: And Mizpah; for he said, The LORD watch between me and thee, when we are absent one from another.
verses.sm: ma 3Mesepa, aua na faapea ana, Ia silasila mai le ALII ia te i taua, pe a ta te‘a eseese o oe ma au.

verses.en: If thou shalt afflict my daughters, or if thou shalt take other wives beside my daughters, no man is with us; see, God is witness betwixt me and thee.
verses.sm: o Afai e ie agaleaga atu i oʻu afafine, pe faaopoopo i oʻu afafine nisi au ava, ua leai se tagata ja te i taua, faauta mai ea, o le Atua c sisila ia ia te i taua ma oe.

verses.en: And Laban said to Jacob, Behold this heap, and behold this pillar, which I have cast betwixt me and thee;
verses.sm: s1 Ua faapea atu foi Lapana ja Iakopo, Faauta mai, o lenei faupuega, faauta mai foi, o lenei faailoga, ua ou faatuina ia te i taua;

verses.en: This heap be witness, and this pillar be witness, that I will not pass over this heap to thee, and that thou shalt not pass over this heap and this pillar unto me, for harm.
verses.sm: ia fai lenei faupuega ma molimau, ia fai foi lenei faailoga ma molimau, ou te le laasia atu lenei faupuega ia te oe, e te le laasia mai foi lenei faupuega ma lenei faailoga ia te au, e fai ai se mea leaga.

verses.en: The God of Abraham, and the God of Nahor, the God of their father, judge betwixt us. And Jacob sware by the fear of his father Isaac.
verses.sm: O le Atua o Aperaamo, o le Atua foi o Nakori, o le Atua o lo laua tamā, ia faamasino mai O ia ja te i taua. Ona tauto ai lea o Iakopo i lē ua mataʻu i ai lona tamā o Isaako.

verses.en: Then Jacob offered sacrifice upon the mount, and called his brethren to eat bread: and they did eat bread, and tarried all night in the mount.
verses.sm: Ona fasi lea e lakopo ni manu i le mauga, ua fai atu foi i ona uso e o mai e aai; ona latou aai ai lea, ua latou nonofo pea foi i le maugg i lea po.

verses.en: And early in the morning Laban rose up, and kissed his sons and his daughters, and blessed them: and Laban departed, and returned unto his place.
verses.sm: Ona tulai lea o Lapana i le taeao lava, ma taufeasogi ma ona atalii ma ona afafine, ua ia faamanuia atu foi ia te i latou; ona alu lea o
